title: Swiggy Restaurant Scraper
description: Collect Swiggy restaurant data from city pages or keyword searches. Provide a Swiggy city URL for the strongest pagination support, or provide a location with a keyword search.

url.title: Swiggy URL
url.description: A Swiggy city or city collection URL such as https://www.swiggy.com/city/bangalore or https://www.swiggy.com/city/bangalore/best-restaurants.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Restaurant or dish keyword to search around the resolved city, such as biryani or pizza.

location.title: Location
location.description: Location to geocode when you are not using a Swiggy URL, such as Bangalore or Koramangala Bangalore.

resultsWanted.title: Results Wanted
resultsWanted.description: Maximum number of restaurants to collect.

maxPages.title: Max Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of Swiggy pages to advance in URL mode when Show More is available.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy configuration. Residential proxies are recommended for the most stable browser-assisted pagination.
